summary.headline: Christianbook captures $1.24M in fully-finalized annual savings across five indirect spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners executed competitive RFPs and negotiations in transportation, packaging and payments that are now fully contracted and live. All five worked categories—Merchant Processing Fees, Corrugated, Packaging & Shipping Supplies, LTL and FTL—have signed agreements delivering $1,237,359 in recurring annual savings. Key wins include 31 % lower LTL costs through a new carrier, 13 % savings in merchant processing via a broker switch, and 14 % price cuts on corrugated while keeping incumbents in place. An additional RFP was run for Ingram Book Group; pricing held flat, so no incremental savings were booked.
